scenario: Beginner, sprint, 3 days, 45 min, race in about 9 weeks (taper)

workouts.title: Easy Swim technique
workouts.description: Focus on smooth breathing and relaxing your shoulders in the water to build confidence.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today completely off to let your body recover and adapt to the new training routine.

workouts.title: Easy Spin Bike
workouts.description: Ride at a comfortable, conversational pace to get your legs used to pedaling.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and focus on drinking plenty of water and eating healthy meals.

workouts.title: Easy Walk-Run
workouts.description: Alternate between light jogging and walking to protect your joints while building endurance.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy your rest day today and prepare mentally for the upcoming weekend.

workouts.title: Active Recovery Rest
workouts.description: Take a gentle walk if you feel stiff, otherwise rest completely to finish week one.

workouts.title: Swim Endurance Practice
workouts.description: Swim continuous laps at an easy pace to improve your overall water stamina.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to give your shoulders and upper body a break from swimming.

workouts.title: Moderate Bike Ride
workouts.description: Pedal at a steady, slightly harder cadence to build leg power and cardiovascular fitness.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest up and let your leg muscles repair after yesterday's bike session.

workouts.title: Steady Run
workouts.description: Maintain a continuous light jog for most of the duration with minimal walking breaks.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a complete day off to keep your energy high for next week.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Relax and enjoy your Sunday off before starting a new training week.

workouts.title: Swim Interval Drills
workouts.description: Mix short fast lengths with easy resting lengths to build speed in the water safely.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today off to recover fully from your hard swim session.

workouts.title: Bike Hill Practice
workouts.description: Find a gentle incline to pedal up, building strength in your thighs and glutes.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest and stretch lightly today to keep your hips and legs loose.

workouts.title: Endurance Run
workouts.description: Run at a steady, comfortable pace without stopping to improve your running stamina.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and make sure you eat nutritious foods to recover.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: A quiet day of rest to finish week three of your training plan.

workouts.title: Recovery Swim
workouts.description: Swim easy laps with a focus on good form and long, relaxed strokes.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest and relax today as part of your scheduled recovery week.

workouts.title: Easy Recovery Spin
workouts.description: Keep your legs spinning lightly on the bike to flush out any lingering fatigue.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy a full day off to let your body absorb the training from previous weeks.

workouts.title: Short Easy Jog
workouts.description: A very short, comfortable run to keep your legs moving without adding stress.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today in preparation for the second half of your training journey.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take Sunday off to rest and recharge your mental energy.

workouts.title: Distance Swim
workouts.description: Build swimming endurance by swimming longer continuous sets with short rests.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take today off to let your upper body recover from the longer swim.

workouts.title: Moderate Bike Ride
workouts.description: Steady riding on flat roads to increase your cycling aerobic fitness.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and stretch your legs gently to prevent stiffness.

workouts.title: Intro Brick Workout
workouts.description: Ride your bike for a short time and then immediately go for a short run to feel heavy legs.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest and recover after completing your first brick workout.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Enjoy a peaceful rest day to close out week five.

workouts.title: Swim Speed Intervals
workouts.description: Incorporate fast swimming intervals to boost your overall speed in the water.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to let your shoulders recover from yesterday's hard intervals.

workouts.title: Longer Bike Ride
workouts.description: Build cycling endurance with a steady effort over a slightly longer distance.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day today to let your lower body recover.

workouts.title: Bike to Run Brick
workouts.description: Transition quickly from cycling to running to practice the signature triathlon feeling.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and relax your muscles after a solid week of training.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: A restful Sunday to prepare your body for week seven.

workouts.title: Endurance Swim
workouts.description: Swim steadily for distance to ensure you are comfortable with the swim leg distance.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and keep your body hydrated and nourished.

workouts.title: Peak Bike Ride
workouts.description: Your longest ride of the plan, keeping a steady and comfortable pace throughout.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to let your legs recover fully from the peak bike session.

workouts.title: Peak Brick Workout
workouts.description: Practice your race transition with a solid bike ride followed immediately by a steady run.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and enjoy the feeling of completing your hardest training week.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest and relax on Sunday before entering the taper phase.

workouts.title: Taper Swim
workouts.description: A shorter, easy swim to maintain feel for the water while letting your body rest.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today as part of your taper and recovery period.

workouts.title: Taper Bike Ride
workouts.description: An easy spin on the bike to keep your legs ticking over without causing fatigue.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Take a rest day today to continue storing up energy for race week.

workouts.title: Taper Run
workouts.description: A light, easy jog to keep your running form sharp while resting your muscles.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest and relax today, letting your body heal completely.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest on Sunday and get ready for your final race week.

workouts.title: Race Week Swim
workouts.description: A very gentle swim with a few short relaxed lengths to stay loose before race day.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today and focus on good nutrition and deep sleep.

workouts.title: Race Week Bike Spin
workouts.description: A short, easy bike ride to make sure your equipment works and your legs feel fresh.

workouts.title: Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest today to let your body store all the energy it needs for the upcoming race.

workouts.title: Race Week Shakeout Run
workouts.description: A very brief, easy jog with a couple of short strides to wake up your running legs.

workouts.title: Pre-Race Rest Day
workouts.description: Rest completely today, check your gear, and get an early night of sleep.

workouts.title: Race Day Preparation
workouts.description: Rest today, stay calm, and get ready for your wonderful triathlon experience.
